example: Complex JSON response with nested objects
note: This demonstrates the structure TaskResponse can handle
notes: Field name mapping: snake_case JSON (created_at) maps to camelCase Kotlin (createdAt)
Nullable fields: user, email, created_at, and due_date can be null
Nested objects: user is a nested UserInfo object
Custom adapter: DateAdapter handles ISO 8601 date strings
Safe defaults: When user is null, createdBy defaults to 'Unknown'
